verdict.rationale: Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant and model platform, not an equity-management or cap-table platform. Defining vesting schedules with cliffs, milestones and acceleration, and tracking vested versus unvested shares automatically, falls outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Claude ships such a capability. Generic features like Artifacts or running code are building blocks, not a vesting-tracking feature.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define custom vesting schedules — cliffs, milestones, acceleration on exit — and the platform tracks vested vs unvested automatically
